product.name: PF-06838435
other_names: Adeno-associated viral vector with human factor IX Padua gene
product.vector_or_capsid: recombinant adeno-associated viral (rAAV) vector comprised of AAV-Spark100 (a bio-engineered hepatotropic AAV capsid)
product.transgene: hFIX39-Padua (a codon-optimized expression cassette encoding a naturally occurring FIX variant, FIX-Padua), under the regulatory control of the liver-specific modified hAAT promoter and portions of the apolipoprotein E hepatic locus control region [ApoE HCR-1]

evidence.quote: FIX gene transfer with PF-06838435 (rAAV-Spark100-hFIX-Padua)

PF-06838435 (generic name: fidanacogene elaparvovec; formerly known as SPK-9001 or rAAV Spark100-hFIX-Padua) is an adeno-associated viral (AAV) vector designed to drive expression of the human factor IX-Padua (hFIX-Padua) transgene and raise the circulating levels of FIX (FIX:C).

It is a recombinant adeno-associated viral (rAAV) vector comprised of AAV-Spark100 (a bio-engineered hepatotropic AAV capsid) and hFIX39-Padua (a codon-optimized expression cassette encoding a naturally occurring FIX variant, FIX-Padua), under the regulatory control of the liver-specific modified hAAT promoter and portions of the apolipoprotein E hepatic locus control region [ApoE HCR-1] (Figure 2).
Utilizes a different AAV capsid, called AAV-Spark100.
Intervention Name PF-06838435 Type Gene therapy
Sourcing Provided centrally by the sponsor.
Current/Former Name(s) or Alias(es) PF-06838435, SPK-9001, AAV-Spark100-hFIX39- Padua, Adeno-associated viral vector with human factor IX Padua gene.
The study treatment, a single infusion of PF-06838435, a gene transfer agent, will be administered on Day 1 at a dose of 5 × 1011 vector genomes/kg of body weight.
Spark Therapeutics has developed a customized AAV vector with enhanced liver tropism with which to deliver the highly active Padua variant of FIX.

notes: Document is Final Protocol Amendment 3 (29 June 2022); printed page numbers match PDF page numbers. Running headers/footers and redaction markers (PPD, CCI on pages 40-41) ignored. Pages 12, 100-107, 121, 129-130 have little or no text (figure, PRO instruments); no page reads '[no text layer on this page]', so no page-image entries. CONFLICTS: (1) ADA target — SoA notes and Appendix 2 say 'Anti-PF-06838435 antibodies (ADA)', Section 8.3.6.1 says 'anti-AAV capsid protein antibodies (ADA)'; the nAb target is 'AAV-Spark100' (exclusion 1, Appendix 2, SoA) but 'PF-06838435 (specifically to the SPK-100 AAV capsid)' in 8.3.6.1. (2) FIX inhibitor units — 'Bethesda Units (BU)' (exclusion 2, SoA) vs '≥0.6 Bu/mL' (Appendix 3 medically important events). (3) FIX activity method — 'chromogenic assay' (Section 8.5) vs 'chromogenic straight assay' (exploratory endpoint). (4) SoA abbreviation footer on page 27 defines EQ-5D-5L as '5 dimensions, 3 levels'; page 23 and Appendix 15 say '5 levels' (both recorded). SoA footers also word FIX:C as 'circulating FIX' and FIX Ag as 'factor IX antigen' vs Appendix 15 'factor IX: circulating' / 'coagulation factor IX antigen' (Appendix 15 entries kept). (5) SoA note on medical history says 'Only changes to historical data ... will be captured', Section 8.3.1 says 'Historical data ... will be captured from the lead-in study'. (6) The Lipid Panel SoA note refers to Appendix 2 for the 8-hour fasting requirement, but Appendix 2 lists only the lipid analytes and says nothing about fasting. (7) Hepatitis: Appendix 2 lists Hepatitis C Virus AB, the SoA note lists 'HCV-RNA Quantitative' but no HCV antibody; SoA row name says 'HBcAB' (Appendix 15: 'HBcAb'). (8) Endpoint text prints 'PMBC' for PBMC. NOT FOUND / NOT STATED: no HLA/KIR typing, vector integration or replication-competent virus testing; no lymphodepleting or other investigational product (a FIX replacement product is infused on Day 1 before IP and participants bring their own; corticosteroids are used for immunomodulation — neither is an investigational product). No method for nAb/ADA beyond 'validated analytical method'; no units for ADA, ELISPOT, FIX antigen, TAT or D-dimer; no specimen stated for panels in Appendix 2 except where noted. Specimen/method for FIX antigen not stated. 'Order the IP', eDiary, PRO, HJHS, ECG, vitals activities have no lab/specimen statements (not in lab_and_purpose). Text layer drops the α in 'α-Fetoprotein' on SoA pages (printed as a symbol-font character) and superscripts (5 × 1011 = 5 × 10^11 vg/kg; 1.00 × 1013 vg/mL); quotes keep the text layer as is. Abbreviations: 120 lines from Appendix 15 (pages 145-148) plus SoA-footer-only terms (CD4, ELISPOT, K, mins, n, Na, PCR, vg) and the conflicting EQ-5D-5L footer entry. SoA activity-name tokens not defined in Appendix 15: CD4, HBcAB, LFTs, PCR, eDiary (PCR and CD4 are defined only in the SoA abbreviation footer; HBcAB differs in case from HBcAb; LFTs is the plural of LFT; eDiary is not defined anywhere).
